metadata.name: trellis_bond
metadata.description: Trellis host bonds: post, unbond, slash with a public dispute window (Backend spec section 5.3)

instructions.name: build_profile
docs: Anyone: the floors compiled into this binary (profile 0 = mainnet, 1 = devnet), as return data.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: The account that paid the proposal's rent, and only it: a proposal closed by a stranger right after execution
would erase the record refunds are settled against (`executed_amount`).

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone may crank execution once the proposal is executable; funds only ever move
to the configured payout accounts. Pays the slash ledger's rent if the bond has none yet.
One exception: a rate-based slash that the cumulative cap would cut today is executed by the slasher only
(`CapCutNeedsSlasher`), so the host cannot crank its own proposal at a moment when it takes nothing.

accounts.name: capacity_claimer
docs: `trellis_capacity`'s claimer PDA; only reachable via CPI from that program.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the proposal rent (the capacity authority that reported the shortfall).

accounts.name: slash_ledger
docs: The bond's slash ledger; created with its first proposal (`init_if_needed`: it is never closed).

accounts.name: bond_lock
docs: What the host locked behind its commitments. The claim is paid for out of it, so the account must exist: a bond
that never locked anything cannot be claimed against.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The initial authority. In production this is a Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig. Must be the program's upgrade
authority, so nobody else can initialise the program between deploy and init.

instructions.name: lock_bond
docs: `trellis_capacity` only (CPI): lock part of a bond behind a capacity commitment.

accounts.name: capacity_claimer
docs: `trellis_capacity`'s claimer PDA; only reachable via CPI from that program.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the lock account's rent the first time (the host committing capacity).

accounts.name: slash_ledger
docs: until the bond's first proposal, and then counts as nothing pending.

accounts.name: bond_lock
docs: `init_if_needed`: the lock is created by the first commitment and never closed, so it cannot be re-initialised.

instructions.name: migrate_config
docs: Grows a config created by an earlier version to the current layout (anyone may pay; works once).

instructions.name: migrate_proposal
docs: Grows a proposal created by an earlier version to the current layout (anyone may pay; works once).

instructions.name: pause
docs: Guardian or authority: pause for `PAUSE_TTL` (72h). A guardian pause cannot be repeated for 7 days.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault holding the bonded USDC; authority is the `HostBond` PDA.

instructions.name: propose_config
docs: Authority: record any config change (including an authority hand-over); it can be applied after
`CONFIG_TIMELOCK` (24h).

accounts.name: refund_pool
docs: Optional replacements for the payout accounts; each must be a USDC token account.

instructions.name: propose_reinstate
docs: Authority: propose to clear `delisted` / `ejected` on a bond. Applicable after `CONFIG_TIMELOCK` (24h).

accounts.name: slasher
docs: The slasher authority (the `slasher` service key; production sits behind the Squads multisig).

accounts.name: slash_ledger
docs: The bond's slash ledger; created with its first proposal (`init_if_needed`: it is never closed).

instructions.name: resolve_config
docs: `apply = true`: the authority installs the pending change after the timelock (a new authority must co-sign).
`apply = false`: the authority drops it (the guardian cannot); anyone may clear an expired one.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Applying or cancelling: the authority. Anyone may clear a proposal that has expired.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: Required only when the pending change hands the authority over: the new authority must sign to take it.

instructions.name: resolve_reinstate
docs: `apply = true`: the authority reinstates the bond after the timelock. `apply = false`: the authority drops the
proposal; anyone may clear an expired one.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Applying or cancelling: the authority. Anyone may clear a proposal that has expired.

instructions.name: unlock_bond
docs: `trellis_capacity` only (CPI): release a settled commitment's lock.

accounts.name: capacity_claimer
docs: `trellis_capacity`'s claimer PDA; only reachable via CPI from that program.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Authority only.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Authority: tightening changes only, effective at once. Loosening is refused (`RequiresTimelock`).

instructions.name: void_proposal
docs: Authority: drop a proposal that has not executed, disputed or not (for example one that can never execute).

accounts.name: bond_lock
docs: the host has committed capacity, and then counts as zero locked.

types.name: BondConfig
docs: Program configuration. Production `authority` is a Squads v4 2-of-3 multisig;
`guardian` (a separate key, held by neither the operator nor the multisig) can only pause new bonds, never move funds.

fields.name: slasher
docs: Account allowed to open slash proposals (the `slasher` service, behind the multisig).

fields.name: refund_pool
docs: Token account that receives the share of a slash earmarked for affected callers.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Token account that receives the remainder of a slash.

fields.name: capacity_claimer
docs: PDA of `trellis_capacity` allowed to file capacity-shortfall claims via CPI.

fields.name: capacity_refund
docs: Token account that receives capacity-shortfall payouts (purchase price of unserved Bushels).

fields.name: paused_until
docs: When the pause lapses by itself (`PAUSE_TTL` after it was last set). `paused` is in force only until then.

fields.name: guardian_pause_ready_at
docs: The guardian may not pause again before this time (`GUARDIAN_PAUSE_COOLDOWN` after its last pause was due to
lapse).

types.name: BondConfigProposalResolved
docs: A pending config change was applied (`applied = true`) or dropped.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: After this the proposal can only be cancelled.

fields.name: changes_capacity_claimer
docs: The proposal names another program address as the one allowed to lock bonds and file capacity claims.

fields.name: changes_payout_accounts
docs: The proposal replaces the refund pool, the treasury or the capacity refund account.

types.name: BondLock
docs: USDC of a bond that is locked behind open capacity commitments. PDA `["lock", host_bond]`.
`trellis_capacity` raises it when a host commits capacity (`lock_bond`, by the commitment's value) and lowers it
when the commitment is settled (`unlock_bond`, by what was not claimed). `withdraw_bond` pays `amount - locked`, so a
host cannot commit capacity, unbond and leave before a shortfall claim arrives. A shortfall claim is paid for out of
the lock: `file_capacity_claim` moves its amount from `locked` to `SlashLedger.pending_claims` and refuses a claim
larger than `locked`, so claims can never take more of a bond than its commitments locked (R3-16).

fields.name: paused_until
docs: When the pause lapses by itself (0 when `paused` is false).

types.name: BuildProfile
docs: What `build_profile` returns: the floors compiled into this binary.

fields.name: profile
docs: 0 = mainnet floors (the default build); 1 = the `devnet` cargo feature.

fields.name: amount
docs: Bonded USDC currently held in the vault and not yet slashed.

fields.name: unbond_at
docs: Unix time after which `withdraw_bond` is allowed; 0 = no unbond requested.

fields.name: strikes
docs: Number of executed slashes against this host.

fields.name: slashed_total
docs: Total USDC slashed over the life of the bond.

fields.name: open_proposals
docs: Proposals that are neither executed nor rejected.

fields.name: next_proposal_id
docs: Next proposal id to be assigned (ids are monotonically increasing).

fields.name: delisted
docs: Set by a quantization-swap or shadow-mismatch slash that took something (not by one the cumulative cap cut to
zero). Blocks new capacity commitments. Cleared only by the authority, through `propose_reinstate` and its
timelock.

fields.name: ejected
docs: Set by a shadow-mismatch slash that took something. Cleared the same way.

fields.name: capacity_claimer
docs: PDA of `trellis_capacity` (seeds `["bond_claimer"]`) allowed to file shortfall claims and lock bonds.

types.name: PendingConfig
docs: A loosening config change waiting out `CONFIG_TIMELOCK`. PDA `["pending_config"]`; one at a time.

fields.name: refund_pool
docs: Replacement payout accounts (mint-checked at proposal), if any.

types.name: PendingReinstate
docs: A reinstatement of a delisted or ejected bond waiting out `CONFIG_TIMELOCK`. PDA `["pending_reinstate", host_bond]`;
one per bond. It loosens (a host that was removed for cheating may back commitments again), so it takes the same
24 hours, the same 7-day expiry and the same authority-only cancel as a config change.

fields.name: strikes
docs: `HostBond.strikes` when this was proposed. A slash executed since then makes the proposal stale: it cannot
clear a delisting it was not proposed for.

types.name: ReinstateProposed
docs: The authority proposed to clear `delisted` / `ejected` on a bond; it can be applied from `effective_at`.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: After this the proposal can only be cancelled.

types.name: ReinstateResolved
docs: A pending reinstatement was applied (`applied = true`: the bond is listed again) or dropped.

types.name: SlashLedger
docs: What has recently been slashed from a bond, and what capacity claims are still open against it.
PDA `["slash_ledger", host_bond]`, created with the bond's first proposal.
Cumulative slash cap: time is cut into fixed windows of `SLASH_WINDOW`; `slashed_current` and `slashed_previous`
are the rate-based slashes executed in the window `now` falls in and in the one before. A slash may only bring
their sum up to `MAX_SLASH_BPS_PER_WINDOW` of the bond as it stood before them. Any interval of `SLASH_WINDOW`
lies inside two adjacent fixed windows, so no such interval ever sees more than the cap: there is no boundary to
straddle (the flaw of a single resetting bucket, security re-review RR-01).
`pending_claims` is the sum of the capacity-shortfall claims filed and not yet executed or rejected. Each was taken
out of `BondLock.locked` when it was filed. It counts against the bond's headroom for new commitments (`lock_bond`),
so headroom stays taken until every claim against a commitment is paid or dropped (RR-07).

fields.name: window_index
docs: `unix_timestamp / SLASH_WINDOW` of `slashed_current`.

fields.name: bps
docs: Rate for rate-based reasons; 0 for `CapacityShortfall`.

fields.name: fixed_amount
docs: Fixed amount for `CapacityShortfall`; 0 for rate-based reasons.

fields.name: refund_amount
docs: Portion of the slash routed to `refund_pool` (rate-based reasons only).

fields.name: window_end
docs: `proposed_at + dispute_window`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Account that paid the proposal's rent; refunded by `close_proposal`.

fields.name: unblock_at
docs: When an open dispute stops blocking execution: `disputed_at` plus the dispute block AS IT WAS when the host
disputed. A later change of the block does not move it (security re-review RR-10). 0 until disputed, and on a
proposal created before this field existed (then `disputed_at + config.dispute_block` applies).

types.name: SlashReason
docs: Slash schedule from Backend spec section 5.3, encoded as reason codes.
| Code | Evidence                                            | Slash                       |
| 1    | Quantization swap (3/3 canaries)                    | 25% (2500 bps) + delist     |
| 2    | Uptime < 95% over 30 days                           | 0.5% (50 bps) per day       |
| 3    | Shadow re-execution mismatch                        | 50% (5000 bps) + ejection   |
| 4    | SEALED served without fresh attestation             | 5% (500 bps) per incident   |
| 5    | Capacity commitment under-delivered (section 5.6)   | exact purchase price of the unserved Bushels (fixed amount, never a rate) |
Borsh encodes variants by declaration order, which matches the reason codes above.

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: The fields `update_config` / `propose_config` may change. `None` leaves a field as it is.

fields.name: new_authority
docs: Hand the authority over. Only through the timelock, and the new authority must sign the apply.
